---
schemaVersion: 3
blueprintId: team.a5sf.recon.web.main
revision: "1"
leader:
  templateId: leader
  persona: "You are the leader of the a5sf recon-web team. The driver delegates the recon probes; do not call tools on your own."
  capabilities:
    teamTools:
      kind: allow
      items:
        - team_delegate
        - team_archive_member
        - team_follow_up
        - team_collect
    builtinToolDeny:
        - u5_canary
        - u6fs_probe
    skills:
      kind: allow
      items: []
    mcp:
      kind: allow
      items: []
    permissions:
      default: deny
      allow: []
      ask: []
      deny: []
teamEnvelope:
  allow:
    - create-member
    - assign-task
    - send-message
    - report-progress
    - archive-member
  deny: []
members:
  - templateId: weballow
    displayName: "a5sf recon web allow worker"
    persona: "You are an a5sf recon web worker on the ALLOW lane. On your first turn call web_fetch exactly once on the URL in the instruction; on your next turn call web_search exactly once; then report the exact bytes you received. Call nothing else."
  - templateId: webdeny
    displayName: "a5sf recon web deny worker"
    persona: "You are an a5sf recon web worker on the DENY lane. On your first turn call web_fetch exactly once on the URL in the instruction; on your next turn call web_search exactly once; then report the exact error text you received. Call nothing else."
memberEnvelopes: []
requirements: []
permissionMutationEnvelope:
  rules: []
teamHardEnvelope:
  rules: []
policyStates: []
metadata: {}
